summary: Colville NF White Mountain cupola-cabin lookout, Ferry County: built 1923, removed 1950; WTA says only steps and nails remain. Duplicate of us-wa-white-mountain.

facts.status_note: Cupola cabin removed in 1950; WTA says cement steps and scattered nails remain at the site.

access.note: Hiking route on the Kettle Crest Trail, listed by WTA. Level is inferred from the trail listing; confirm with the Colville National Forest.

visit.trail_note: WTA hike is 28 miles round trip; the side trip to the old lookout site is described as an easy mile.

events.note: Trail and telephone line built to the summit in the fall

Registered November 23, 2012; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: Register coordinates are N 48.511480° W 118.453420°. The record's point is about 50 km north of that, and the same lookout is described as 16 miles ESE of Republic. The record's coordinates came from the west_us_lookouts import.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 1919 and firelookout.com gives 1922. A September 1923 report says the cabin was completed by July 1, 1923, so the story uses 1923.
firelookout.com says destroyed in 1950; the register and WillhiteWeb say removed. The story says removed.

sources.title: White Mountain via Kettle Crest Trail South

notes_for_editor: Duplicate of us-wa-white-mountain (FFLOS US 1479 / WA 379): same Ferry County, Colville NF cupola cabin, 1923 build, 1950 removal. The register coordinates match that record; this record's point does not. Recommend merging into us-wa-white-mountain and correcting location. That record says gone; WTA describes steps and nails remaining, so ruins fits better. Access 'public' is inferred from the WTA hike listing. No photos added: none with a license in the sources read. Staffing left as events only; facts.staffing not set because no source gives a current status.
